Create function CDN.WartoscWWalucieSys(@Wartosc decimal(16,4), @Waluta varchar(3), @NrKursu integer, @Data integer ) Returns Decimal(16,4) As Begin declare @WartoscSys decimal(16,4)
Set @WartoscSys = @Wartosc *ISNULL( ( SELECT top 1 WaE_KursL/WaE_KursM FROM CDN.WalElem WHERE WaE_Symbol = @Waluta AND WaE_Lp = @NrKursu AND WaE_KursTS<@Data ORDER BY -WaE_KursTS ), 1)
Return (@WartoscSys)
End
